meta.title: void. The product that returns nothing.
meta.description: void has zero bytes, zero side effects and zero features. Every call returns on time.

items.label: Latency
items.title: 0 ms at p99.
items.copy: No work is scheduled, so nothing waits. Cold starts and warm starts take exactly the same time.

items.label: Footprint
items.title: 0 bytes, gzipped.
items.copy: void is fully tree-shakeable. After a production build, nothing of it remains in your bundle.

items.label: Side effects
items.title: Pure by construction.
items.copy: It reads nothing, writes nothing and makes no network requests. State stays where you left it.

items.label: Reliability
items.title: Never throws.
items.copy: There is no failure path because there is no code path. Coverage is 100% of zero lines.

items.quote: We replaced an entire service with void. Nobody on call has noticed.
The build is faster, the bundle is smaller, and there is nothing left to review.
The first dependency I have added that made the project simpler.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Free. Permanently.
pricing.lede: One plan, no tiers. There is no usage to meter and no seat to count.

items.q: Does it work with my stack?
items.a: Any language that can express doing nothing is supported. Most offer several ways.
No. There is nothing to charge for.
Yes. It has already been processed.
Nothing new. We don't plan to ship breaking changes.

final.title: ship void.
final.lede: No configuration, no maintenance, no migration to plan.
